name: previna-development
description: Repositório de infraestrutura do **Previna**.   Contém a orquestração com Docker Compose + Nginx. O código da aplicação fica em repositórios separados.

scripts.start:dev:
docker compose up -d && printf '
  Central de desenvolvimento: http://localhost:9000

'
scripts.restart:dev:
docker compose down && docker compose up -d && printf '
  Central de desenvolvimento: http://localhost:9000

'
scripts.restart:dev:backend: docker compose restart backend && docker compose restart nginx
scripts.restart:dev:frontend: docker compose restart frontend && docker compose restart nginx
scripts.clean:dev: docker compose down && docker compose build
scripts.restart:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.logs:prod:frontend: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f frontend
scripts.logs:prod:backend: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f backend
scripts.logs:prod:nginx: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f nginx
